Render ONE complete polished hand-drawn 2D cel-shaded fighting-game sprite with clean dark outlines and clear flat colour regions. No floor, cast shadow, glow, background, frame, text, watermark, duplicate body, speed lines or motion blur. Anatomical consistency is mandatory: one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Native facing must be SCREEN-RIGHT; do not mirror anatomical costume details.
